rows.grounds: gerund of prāp indicating completion before renunciation
connects obtaining truth to subsequent renunciation
compound of karma and parigraha as object renounced

items.question: What does the yogi renounce after obtaining truth?
items.inference: The verse states that after obtaining truth, the yogi renounces attachment to action.
uncertainties: No edition variant noted in supplied context
items.plain_english: Having obtained truth, the yogi thus renounces attachment to action.
